title: Sulfur Oxidation
description: Use Sulfur Spikes to oxidize Copper blocks!
body:
You can destroy an entire Trial Chamber for Oxidized Copper, but if you want to get some yourself you have to sit and wait? Why not speed up the process a bit? Sulfur Oxidation lets you craft any Copper block with a Sulfur Spike to change it to the next oxidation state! This pack is compatible with my [**Palette**](https://modrinth.com/datapack/palette) pack, which overhauls how recipes for block sets work! To use both, have this pack selected BELOW Palette. ## ### MintRefresh:
